data.title: Pokemon Scarlet Violet: Get Mew & Mewtwo!!

data.title_japanese: 『ポケットモンスター スカーレット・バイオレット』「Get Mew & Mewtwo !!」
data.synopsis: A promotional video for the Get Mew & Mewtwo!! event in Pokemon Scarlet Violet. For a limited time, you could redeem a Mystery Gift to get Mew, a Pokemon which can not be encountered normally in the game. You could then battle Mew against Mewtwo in a Tera Raid Battle for the opportunity to get Mewtwo.

data.title: Youan Xiao Jing de Gui
data.synopsis:
During the White Terror era, Shi Shuifang, a woman who advocated ideas bravely in the underground political organization, seemed to be a light that illuminated the times. The agent of the surveillance organization was influenced by Shi Shuifang and thus fell in love with her. However, under all kinds of unfavorable circumstances, he could only watch her hopelessly suffer through various injuries.

(Source: IMDB)

data.title: Xue Wang Jiadao
data.synopsis:
The ice cream scepter was mysteriously stolen. In order to regain the scepter and save the ice continent, Snow King chased the scepter thief all the way to Hunting Valley, and accidentally met the bounty hunter "Boss Rabbit" whose dream is to make money to revitalize the restaurant. In this way, with their own goals, the two started a fun adventure to find the scepter together.

(Source: iqiyi.com, translated)
